description: This file defines a PHP trait 'StreamDecoratorTrait' used for decorating stream objects in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library. It provides methods for stream manipulation, magic methods, and a placeholder for creating streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trait with a StreamInterface object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to lazily create and access the 'stream' property.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string, seeking to start if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the wrapped stream object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new stream; to be implemented in subclasses.
